create_timestamp_logger: create a TimestampLogger that wraps an existing logger and adds a timestamp key to every log entry
write_timestamped_values: write logging data through a TimestampLogger so each entry includes the current time under a custom key
close_timestamp_logger: close a TimestampLogger instance which also closes the underlying wrapped logger
review_timestamp_logger_init: review the TimestampLogger constructor to understand how it stores the wrapped logger and timestamp key
refactor_timestamp_logger_write: refactor the TimestampLogger write method to add additional metadata fields alongside the timestamp
